system.name: SpeContext
system.one_liner: an algorithm-system co-design that uses a distilled LM's retrieval head to speculatively prefetch sparse KV cache for long-context LLM reasoning

components.name: Input_id
components.role: token id input to the Distilled LM

components.name: Embedding
components.role: embeds input tokens for the DLM

components.name: Query
components.role: query projection of the DLM's single decoder layer

components.name: Key
components.role: key projection of the DLM's single decoder layer

components.name: Value
components.role: value projection, pruned since only attention weights are needed for retrieval

components.name: Attention Weights
components.role: retained output used to identify globally important tokens

components.name: FFN
components.role: feed-forward block of the DLM, pruned away as redundant for retrieval

components.name: Output / Logits / Output_id
components.role: DLM output head, pruned away as redundant for retrieval

components.name: Head-Level Top-K
components.role: selects important tokens independently per attention head

components.name: Batch-Level Top-K
components.role: selects a single set of important tokens shared across all heads (coarser baseline)

components.name: Retrieval Head
components.role: the pruned DLM component producing per-head attention weights for token selection

components.name: LLM
components.role: the original LLM whose KV cache is sparsified using the retrieval head's selection

components.name: Head-level KV Cache
components.role: original LLM's per-head KV cache from which selected entries are gathered

components.name: Gather
components.role: maps selected token indices from the retrieval head onto the LLM's KV cache via torch.gather

components.name: Group-level Element-wise Max
components.role: aggregates per-head attention weights within a KV group for GQA/MQA support

components.name: Projection
components.role: maps the selected latent cache to a higher-dimensional space for MLA support

components.name: Head-level c Cache
components.role: MLA's low-dimensional latent KV cache subjected to selection and dimension expansion

flows.what: selected token indices / top-K attention weights
selected KV pairs loaded into LLM attention

content.key_idea: A pruned distilled LM (keeping only embedding and QK projections) produces per-head attention weights that are top-K selected and gathered into the original LLM's KV cache, with the same gather mechanism adapted to MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA by grouping heads or projecting the latent cache appropriately.
content.reading_order: Panel (a) on the left shows the pruned Distilled LM architecture and bar charts comparing head-level vs batch-level retrieval; panels (b)-(e) to the right show the retrieval-head-to-LLM gather mechanism instantiated for MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA respectively.

evidence: We design the lightweight retrieval head by pruning redundancy and adopt the head-level attention weights for selection
the head-level retrieval exhibits a higher similarity of the important tokens and higher hit rate
GQA divides the query heads into groups, where all heads in the group share the same KV cache

summary: This five-panel figure details SpeContext's lightweight retrieval head design and its adaptation to different attention mechanisms. Panel (a) shows the pruned Distilled LM Architecture: after embedding and Query/Key projection produce attention weights, the Value projection, FFN, and output head are pruned away (marked by a green diagonal 'Pruned' watermark) since only attention weights are needed; two bar charts compare head-level versus batch-level top-K retrieval, showing head-level retrieval achieves higher attention-weight accumulation and hit rate as K grows. Panels (b)-(e) each show the same retrieval-head-to-LLM gather mechanism instantiated for Multi-Head Attention, Grouped-Query Attention, Multi-Query Attention, and Multi-Head Latent Attention respectively, using element-wise max aggregation for grouped heads (GQA/MQA) and a projection step for MLA's latent cache. Colors distinguish pruned (green-watermarked gray) versus retained (salmon-highlighted) components, with red arrows marking the gather operation.
summary_zh: 该图展示SpeContext轻量检索头设计：(a) 蒸馏模型仅保留嵌入和QK投影计算注意力权重，其余部分(Value、FFN、输出头)被剪除（绿色对角'Pruned'水印标注），柱状图比较头级与批级Top-K检索效果；(b)~(e) 分别展示该检索-聚集机制适配MHA、GQA、MQA、MLA四种注意力机制的实现方式。
